田沢湖 (Tazawako) is the name of a lake. 湖 (ko) means lake. The number indicates distance in kilometers.
盛岡 (Morioka) is a city name. 駅 (eki) means station. The number indicates distance in kilometers.

where_youd_see_it: On a Japanese national highway or major road, indicating directions and distances to cities and landmarks.
cultural_note: Japanese road signs frequently include both Japanese (Kanji and Kana) and English text, often with Romaji (romanization of Japanese) for place names, to assist international travelers. This makes them relatively easy for non-Japanese speakers to navigate.
